title: Claim extraction (Gemini extract/classify only)
description: claimExtract.ts: a generateStructured() pass that extracts every customer factual claim from an asset body into ClaimRecord[] {claim_text,claim_kind,numeric?{value,unit,bound},span}. Gemini ONLY extracts/classifies — it never certifies truth and never sets verification. Ledgered + budgeted. Returns ok:false on NOT_CONFIGURED/parse failure (so the gate can fail closed). This pass is invoked by the gate fold AFTER the cheap structural gates.
acceptanceCriteria: extracts numeric claims with parsed {value,unit,bound}

title: Deterministic claim verify (resolve+decide+backstop, unit-normalized bound)
description: claimVerify.ts: PURE deterministic. (1) BACKSTOP: independent raw-body scan (superlative lexicon + numeric regex) over the body; any flagged span with no matching extracted ClaimRecord -> needs_human. (2) RESOLVE: match each ClaimRecord to a claim_source row, STORE claim.resolved_source_id = that row id (structural binding, no substring stamp); numeric claims must satisfy a UNIT/SCALE-NORMALIZED bound compare against the source's typed {numeric_value,numeric_unit,numeric_bound} (30% vs 'up to 50%' fails; 2x vs 200% normalizes). (3) DECIDE: all verified -> pass; unresolved superlative/comparative OR unsigned customer_attested OR backstop-flagged-unextracted -> needs_human; numeric exceeding normalized bound -> block. FAIL CLOSED: claims present but extraction empty/failed while backstop found spans -> needs_human, never pass. No auto-pass path trusts an LLM-authored in-asset source.
acceptanceCriteria: a claim resolving to a source stores resolved_source_id = the exact row id
numeric over the normalized bound -> block; 30% vs attested 'up to 50%' -> not auto-pass
empty/failed extraction with a backstop-detected numeric -> needs_human (fail closed)
superlative with no source row never auto-passes; pure/deterministic, no LLM

title: The five §7 content gates (structural) + jsonLdShape gate
description: phrasingVariation (§7#1): import dedup.ts normalizeText/trigramJaccard; max similarity against ALL OTHER same-language assets in ctx.siblings (NOT scoped to phrasing_group_id), cross-language exempt; block if >= CONTENT_DUP_THRESHOLD (config constant, fixture-tuned on long blocks, documented as needing emora/k-beauty tuning). verifiableNumbers (§7#2): per-language superlative lexicon (config/content-terms) + every numeric token must resolve to a claims[] ClaimRecord with resolved_source_id. noFakeSignals (§7#3): structural — reject review/testimonial/vote-count scaffolding + unsourced usage-count claims (community/review channel_class already excluded by enum). disclosure (§7#6): channel_class in {pr_wire,directory,web2,social} must carry a non-null disclosure_tag from the controlled vocab. claimVerification (§7#7): wraps claimVerify + claimExtract, fail-closed. jsonLdShape (content_type='jsonld' only): assert @context/@type/required-fields + deferred-url token shape + RE-RUN superlative+numeric checks over nested JSON-LD strings.
acceptanceCriteria: phrasing gate blocks cross-meaning boilerplate copy-paste in the same language, exempts cross-language pairs
verifiableNumbers blocks a bare unsourced number and an unbounded superlative
disclosure blocks a pr_wire asset with null disclosure_tag
jsonLdShape blocks a 'best-in-class' string inside articleBody
